title: Console Automation page (M)
description:
Add an Automation page to the CMS console, built on the existing Administration -> Procedures panel.

Scope:
- List of automations with their triggers (monitor, schedule, event, manual), enabled state and next run.
- Recent runs with status, cost and links to the LLM context of each run.
- Failures view, including missed schedules.
- Enable/disable, and a manual Run button, for editors and admins only.
- Shows each automation's direct-publish opt-in (review-by-default story).
- Code is viewable but not editable here; code changes go through PRs.

Acceptance criteria:
- The page lists automations, triggers and recent runs for the site.
- Editors and admins can enable/disable and press Run; other roles see the page read-only.
- A failed run appears under failures with a link to its LLM context.
- Gherkin specs (narrative, complete) required, including role permissions.

Depends on the automation records story and the review-by-default story.
